title: stelis ornata
intro: Stelis ornata, commonly known as the "Pride of Barbados," is a flowering plant native to the tropical regions of the Americas. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its ability to promote wound healing, reduce inflammation, and alleviate various health issues. The therapeutic actions of Stelis ornata are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which possess anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The health benefits of Stelis ornata include reducing fever, relieving pain, and treating skin conditions, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
